verdict.rationale: The reflect.app homepage calls Reflect "an open-source note-taking app" and says "Open source. Explore the code on GitHub," so the vendor does claim readable public source. That claim is thin: no license is named, no repository URL or contents are cited, and it describes local Markdown files with iCloud/Git sync, which sits oddly beside the rest of the docs describing an end-to-end encrypted hosted service. Nothing in the pack concretely shows the code is closed, so this is not disputed. Missing for 10: a named open-source license, a linked and verifiable GitHub repository, clarity on whether the open code covers the main Reflect app, and independent corroboration of source availability.
